verdict.rationale: The llms.txt probe notes that the www.uscis.gov Crawl-delay 10 was honored, which implies the main site serves a readable robots.txt with crawl directives. However, the public case-status host returns HTTP 403 behind a Cloudflare challenge at robots.txt itself, so an agent cannot learn its rules there before fetching. Missing for 10: direct evidence of the www.uscis.gov robots.txt contents, a reachable robots.txt on egov.uscis.gov, and consistent machine-readable access rules across USCIS hosts.
